Physically imposing sedacthies prove their status by controlling dangerous aquatic creatures like [great white sharks](/Monsters.aspx?ID=365) and [giant moray eels](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2971). **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 19 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 [Sedacthy Marauder](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3179) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 300 **Perception** +9; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [wavesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=84) 30 feet **Languages** [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113); sea speech **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +14, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +13, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +9 **Str** +6 **Dex** +3 **Con** +4 **Int** +0 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +3 **Sea Speech** A sedacthy speaking [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113) can be understood by any [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) that has a swim Speed or the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=529) or [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=533) trait. By spending a week regularly interacting with such an animal, the sedacthy can make it permanently [helpful](/Conditions.aspx?ID=78). **Items** [Breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=10), [Spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=10) (2) --- **AC** 19 **Fort** +14 **Ref** +9 **Will** +9 **HP** 75 **Vengeful Throw** **Trigger** The marauder takes damage from a creature 20 feet or further away; **Effect** The marauder makes a ranged spear Strike against the triggering creature. This attack doesn't take a range increment penalty if the target is within the second range increment. --- **Speed** 20 feet, swim 40 feet **Melee** spear +14, **Damage** 1d6+10 piercing **Melee** jaws +14, **Damage** 1d4+8 piercing plus 1d4 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Melee** claw +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 2d4+8 slashing **Ranged** spear +11 ([thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 1d6+10 piercing **Challenging Shriek** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The marauder unleashes a terrifying battle cry. Each enemy in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 21 Will save. Regardless of the results, creatures are temporarily immune for 1 minute.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76).
**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.
**Critical Failure** The creature is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) for 1 round and frightened 3. **Shared Feast** The sedacthy makes a jaws Strike. If it hits, an ally of their choice can spend a reaction to make a jaws Strike against the same target. Allies with beaks or similar attacks can use those instead of jaws.
name: Sedacthy Marauder
